verdict.rationale: System-wide dictation is a fair question for a desktop operating system, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents only output-side accessibility features (screen reader, read the screen aloud, Braille) and keyboard aids. Nothing covers built-in speech-to-text or AI dictation in any form.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can dictate text anywhere in the system using built-in AI dictation
